verdict.rationale: Shortcut's pricing page says you can create additional Workspaces for Sandboxing, which gives a separate space for testing apart from production work. It is a single marketing-level mention: nothing describes a dedicated sandbox API environment, how data is isolated, or how agents and API tokens would be pointed at the sandbox. Missing for 10: dedicated sandbox or test API environment docs, data isolation and seeding details, guidance for agent/API use against a sandbox workspace, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Create additional Workspaces for Sandboxing, to protect sensitive information, or for Agencies who want to separate clients work
